examples.en: My friend lives in the US now.
It's night in the US right now.
New York is in the United States.
The United States is very big.

explain: 미국 사람은 “미국인”이라고도 해요. “인”은 사람이라는 뜻이에요. 미국인은 뉴스나 글에서 많이 써요.
explain_en: An American can be 미국 사람 or 미국인. 인 means “person”. 미국인 is more common in news and writing.

examples.en: I traveled to Japan last summer.
Japan is next to Korea.
I work at a Japanese company.
I'm going to Japan next week.

explain: 두 나라 이름을 짧게 합칠 때가 있어요. 한국 + 일본 = “한일”, 한국 + 중국 = “한중”이에요. 뉴스에 자주 나와요.
explain_en: Korean often joins two country names into a short word: 한국 + 일본 = 한일, 한국 + 중국 = 한중. You will see these in the news.

examples.en: The weather in the UK is often cloudy.
British people drink a lot of tea.
My younger sibling goes to university in the UK.
I often watch British dramas.
London is the capital of the UK.

explain: 한국에서 영국은 보통 UK 전체예요. 축구에서는 “잉글랜드”라고 많이 불러요.

explain_en: In everyday Korean, 영국 usually means the whole UK. In football (soccer), people say 잉글랜드 for England.

examples.en: I have a lot of Korean friends.
examples.extra_word: 많다 = to be many, a lot

examples.en: I live in Korea now.
Korean money is the won.
Seoul is in Korea.

explain: 한국 사람들은 자기 나라를 말할 때 '한국'보다 '우리나라'를 많이 써요. 학교 과목 이름도 '한국어'가 아니라 '국어'예요.

phrases.example: 김치를 이렇게 잘 먹어요? 한국 사람 다 됐네요!
phrases.en: You've practically become Korean!
phrases.nuance_ko: 한국 생활에 익숙한 외국인을 칭찬할 때
phrases.nuance_en: praises a foreigner who has gotten used to life in Korea
phrases.en_equiv: You've practically become Korean!

explain_en: When Koreans talk about their own country, they often say '우리나라' (our country) rather than '한국'. Even the school subject is called '국어' (the national language), not '한국어'.

examples.en: Malaysia is hot all year round.
I have a friend from Malaysia.
It rains often in Malaysia.
There is a Malaysian restaurant in our neighborhood.
I met a friend in Malaysia during vacation.

explain: “말레이시아”와 “인도네시아”는 이름이 비슷해서 헷갈려요. “말레이”로 시작하면 말레이시아, “인도네”로 시작하면 인도네시아예요.
explain_en: 말레이시아 and 인도네시아 look alike and are easy to mix up. If it starts with 말레이 it is Malaysia; if it starts with 인도네 it is Indonesia.

examples.en: Thai food is spicy and sweet.
There are many elephants in Thailand.
Thailand is always hot.
A friend is coming from Thailand tomorrow.

explain: 태국은 “타이”라고도 해요. 예를 들면 “타이 마사지”예요. 둘 다 같은 나라를 말해요.
explain_en: Thailand can also be 타이, as in 타이 마사지. Both words point to the same country.

examples.en: My friend is Chinese.
I really love Chinese food.

examples.ko: 중국에 친구가 있어요? — 네, 베이징에 있어요.
examples.en: Do you have friends in China? — Yes, in Beijing.
I drink Chinese tea on weekends.
I often watch Chinese movies.

explain: 한국에서 “중국집”은 중국 음식 가게예요. 짜장면과 짬뽕을 많이 팔아요.
explain_en: In Korea, a 중국집 is a Chinese restaurant. It is the place for 짜장면 and 짬뽕.

examples.en: Winters in Canada are very cold.
My friend is from Canada.
Canada is very far from Korea.
What is Canada like? — It's very big.
I'm going to go to Canada in the summer.

explain: “카나다”가 아니라 “캐나다”라고 써요. 첫 글자는 “캐”예요. 발음도 [캐나다]예요.
explain_en: It is written 캐나다, not 카나다. The first letter is 캐, and you say it that way too.

examples.en: Indonesia has a lot of islands.
I want to go to Bali in Indonesia.
My Indonesian friend likes Korean songs.
I worked in Indonesia last year.

examples.ko: 인도네시아는 어디에 있어요? — 말레이시아 옆에 있어요.
examples.en: Where is Indonesia? — It is next to Malaysia.

explain: 이름이 길어서 뉴스에서는 “인니”라고 줄여서 쓰기도 해요. 보통 말할 때는 “인도네시아”라고 해요.
explain_en: The name is long, so news and online text sometimes shorten it to 인니. In normal speech you say 인도네시아.

examples.en: My husband is German.
I drank beer in Germany.
German cars are very famous.
I often take the train in Germany.

explain: 독일은 쓸 때와 말할 때가 달라요. [도길]이라고 읽어요. 받침 ㄱ이 다음 소리로 가요.
explain_en: 독일 is pronounced [도길]. The final ㄱ of 독 moves onto the next syllable, so it sounds different from how it is written.

examples.en: Russian winters are really long and cold.
Russia is the biggest country in the world.
Russia is a very big country.
My Russian friend likes kimchi.
I want to go to Russia in winter.

explain: “로시아”가 아니라 “러시아”예요. 첫 글자가 “러”예요. 러시아 말은 “러시아어”예요.
explain_en: It is 러시아, not 로시아. The first letter is 러. The language is 러시아어.

examples.en: Mongolians are good at riding horses.
Mongolia has more horses than people.
My Mongolian friend works at a company in Seoul.
The sky in Mongolia is really beautiful.
A friend is coming from Mongolia next month.

explain: 예전에는 “몽고”라고도 썼어요. 지금은 “몽골”이라고 써요. 오래된 책이나 말에서 “몽고”가 나오기도 해요.
explain_en: It used to be written 몽고 in Korean too. Today you write 몽골. You may still see 몽고 in older books or hear it in older speech.

examples.en: In Vietnam, people often eat noodles for breakfast.
Vietnamese coffee is very sweet.
I want to eat Vietnamese rice noodles.
A friend came to Korea from Vietnam.
I'm going to meet my Vietnamese friend tomorrow.

explain: 한국어로는 “비엣남”이 아니라 “베트남”이에요. 처음 소리가 “베”예요. 쌀국수 가게도 “베트남 쌀국수”라고 많이 써요.
explain_en: In Korean it is 베트남, not 비엣남. It starts with the sound 베. Noodle shops often put 베트남 in the name too: 베트남 쌀국수.

examples.en: Paris is in France.
I like French films.
I'm meeting my French friend in Paris.
France is famous for its bread.
I'm going to France this year.

explain: 나라 이름 뒤에 “어”를 붙이면 그 나라 말이 돼요. 프랑스어, 중국어, 일본어가 그래요. 영어만 조금 달라요.
explain_en: Add 어 after a country name to get its language: 프랑스어, 중국어, 일본어. English is the odd one out: 영어, not 영국어.

examples.en: I drink coffee.
The coffee is too bitter.
I drink coffee every day.
One iced coffee, please.
Do you drink coffee? — No, I drink water.
There are lots of coffee shops in front of my office.

explain: 한국은 카페가 정말 많은 나라예요. 점심을 먹고 동료들과 카페에 가는 게 거의 하루 일과예요.

phrases.en: The patient's family waits here.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병원에서 환자와 같이 온 가족을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the family members who come with a patient to the hospital.
phrases.en_equiv: patient's family

explain_en: Hospital staff call a patient "환자분". "분" is a word that shows respect for a person. When someone at a hospital calls "환자분!", they are calling you.

examples.en: Brazil is a country famous for soccer.
I'm Brazilian.
I want to go to Brazil.
Brazil is famous for coffee.
I have lunch with my Brazilian friend.
Where is Brazil? — It is in South America.

explain: 브라질 사람들은 스페인어가 아니라 포르투갈어를 써요. 남미에서 포르투갈어를 쓰는 큰 나라는 브라질이에요.
explain_en: People in Brazil speak Portuguese, not Spanish. The big Portuguese-speaking country in South America is 브라질.

examples.en: I'm Spanish.
I want to go to Spain.
Spain is very hot in summer.

examples.ko: 스페인 음식을 좋아해요? — 네, 파에야를 좋아해요.
examples.en: Do you like Spanish food? — Yes, I like paella.
I watched a soccer match in Spain.

explain: “에스파냐”라는 이름도 있어요. 하지만 보통은 “스페인”이라고 말해요. 말은 “스페인어”예요.
explain_en: There is also the name "에스파냐". But people usually say "스페인". The language is "스페인어".

examples.ko: 멕시코 음식은 조금 매워도 아주 맛있어요.
examples.en: Mexican food is a little spicy, but it is very delicious.
I'm Mexican.
I want to go to Mexico.
I eat tacos at a Mexican restaurant.
My Mexican friend lives in Seoul.
Mexico has a really large population.

explain: “멕시코”는 [멕씨코]로 소리 나요. ㄱ 받침 뒤의 ㅅ이 된소리가 돼요. 글자는 “시”인데 [씨]로 말해요.
explain_en: "멕시코" is pronounced [멕씨코]. After the ㄱ final consonant, ㅅ becomes a tense sound. The letter is "시" but you say [씨].

examples.en: I still think about the pizza I ate in Italy.
I'm Italian.
I want to go to Italy.
I eat pizza at an Italian restaurant.
My Italian friend loves coffee.
I bought Italian shoes. They are really comfortable.

explain: 예전 이름 “이태리”를 아직도 가끔 들을 수 있어요. 지금 이름은 “이탈리아”예요.

phrases.en: At the bathhouse I scrub off dead skin with an 'Italy towel'.
phrases.nuance_ko: 때를 미는 까슬까슬한 수건이에요. 옛 이름 ‘이태리’가 이 말 속에 남아 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: a rough towel for scrubbing off dead skin; the old name '이태리' remains in this word
phrases.en_equiv: At the bathhouse I scrub off dead skin with an 'Italy towel'.

explain_en: You can still sometimes hear the old name "이태리". The current name is "이탈리아".

examples.en: I'm Indian.
I want to go to India.
I eat naan at an Indian restaurant.
India has a huge number of people.
People also use English a lot in India.

explain: 차가 다니는 길(차도) 옆에 사람이 걷는 길이에요. 나라 이름 '인도(India)'와 소리가 같아서 문장을 보고 구분해요.

phrases.en: sidewalk and roadway
phrases.en_equiv: sidewalk and roadway

explain_en: The path beside the road where people walk. It sounds the same as 인도 (India), so tell them apart by context.

examples.en: My family swam in the sea in the Philippines.
I'm Filipino.
I want to go to the Philippines.
The sea in the Philippines is really beautiful.
My Filipino friend speaks English well.
Philippine mangoes are very sweet.

explain: 한국어에는 영어의 F 소리가 없어요. 그래서 F를 “ㅍ”으로 써요. 필리핀의 “필”은 Phil이에요. 프랑스의 “프”도 그래요.
explain_en: Korean has no English F sound, so F is written as "ㅍ". The "필" in 필리핀 is Phil. The "프" in 프랑스 works the same way.

examples.en: I'm Turkish.
I want to go to Türkiye (Turkey).
Türkiye is famous for coffee and tea.
My Turkish friend likes Korea.
I'm going on a trip to Türkiye next year.

explain: 예전에는 “터키”라고 많이 썼어요. 지금은 나라 이름이 “튀르키예”예요. 하지만 사람들은 아직 “터키”라고도 말해요.
explain_en: People used to say "터키" a lot. The country's name is now "튀르키예". But people still also say "터키".

examples.en: I am going to go to Egypt next year.
I'm Egyptian.
I want to go to Egypt.
There are pyramids in Egypt.
My Egyptian friend watches Korean dramas.
I took a lot of photos in Egypt.

explain: 이집트 사람들은 아랍어를 써요. ‘이집트어’라고 하지 않아요. ‘나라 이름 + 어’ 규칙이 맞지 않는 나라예요.
explain_en: Egyptians speak Arabic; Koreans don't say '이집트어'. It's a country where the 'country name + 어' rule for languages doesn't work.

examples.en: I'm Polish.
I want to go to Poland.
Winters in Poland are long and cold.
Polish food includes dumplings.
I took a train in Poland.

explain: 영어 “land”가 들어간 나라 이름은 “란드”나 “랜드”로 써요. 폴란드, 핀란드는 “란드”이고, 뉴질랜드, 아일랜드는 “랜드”예요.
explain_en: Country names with English "land" are written "란드" or "랜드". 폴란드 and 핀란드 use "란드"; 뉴질랜드 and 아일랜드 use "랜드".

examples.ko: 수진 씨는 우크라이나 친구와 이메일을 주고받아요.
examples.en: Sujin exchanges emails with a friend from Ukraine.
I'm Ukrainian.
I want to go to Ukraine.
My Ukrainian friend studies Korean hard.
Ukraine is famous for wheat.
Among Ukrainian foods, borscht is delicious.

explain: 우크라이나 사람들은 우크라이나어를 써요. 영어 Ukraine과 달리 한국어 이름은 끝이 ‘-나’로 끝나요. ‘우크라인’이라고 쓰지 않게 조심하세요.
explain_en: Ukrainians speak Ukrainian (우크라이나어). Unlike English 'Ukraine', the Korean name ends in -나, so don't write '우크라인'.

examples.en: I'm Dutch.
I want to go to the Netherlands.
The Netherlands is famous for tulips.
A friend from the Netherlands works in Seoul.
I bought cheese in the Netherlands.

explain: 영어로 Holland라고도 해서 ‘홀란드’, 옛 한자 이름 ‘화란’을 들을 때가 있어요. 지금 정식 이름은 ‘네덜란드’예요. 말은 ‘네덜란드어’예요.
explain_en: Because English also says 'Holland', you may hear 홀란드 or the old Sino-Korean name 화란. The official name today is 네덜란드, and the language is 네덜란드어.

examples.ko: 스웨덴 친구가 다음 달에 한국에 와요.
examples.en: My Swedish friend is coming to Korea next month.
I'm Swedish.
I want to go to Sweden.
In Sweden, the nights are long in winter.
There is a Swedish furniture store in Korea too.
I work together with a Swedish friend.

explain: “스웨덴”과 “스위스”는 둘 다 “스”로 시작해서 헷갈려요. 스웨덴은 Sweden, 스위스는 Switzerland예요.
explain_en: "스웨덴" and "스위스" both start with "스", so they get mixed up. 스웨덴 is Sweden and 스위스 is Switzerland.

examples.en: Argentina is a country very far from Korea.
I'm Argentine.
I want to go to Argentina.
Argentina is famous for its beef.
I learned tango in Argentina.

examples.ko: 아르헨티나 친구는 한국 음식을 잘 먹어요.
examples.en: My Argentine friend eats Korean food well.

explain: 아르헨티나 사람들은 스페인어를 써요. 그래서 이름도 스페인어 소리를 따라 ‘아르젠티나’가 아니라 ‘아르헨티나’로 써요.
explain_en: Argentinians speak Spanish, so the Korean name follows the Spanish sound: 아르헨티나, not '아르젠티나'.

examples.ko: 콜롬비아 커피는 향이 좋아서 인기가 많아요.
examples.en: Colombian coffee is very popular because it smells good.
I'm Colombian.
I want to go to Colombia.
Colombia is in the north of South America.
My Colombian friend studies in Seoul.
They speak Spanish in Colombia.

explain: “콜롬비아”는 나라이고, 미국 대학 이름은 “컬럼비아”예요. 영어로는 비슷하지만 한국어로는 달라요.
explain_en: "콜롬비아" is the country, and the American university is "컬럼비아". They look alike in English but differ in Korean.

examples.ko: 페루에는 높은 산과 오래된 도시가 많아요.
examples.en: Peru has many high mountains and old cities.
I'm Peruvian.
I want to go to Peru.
I ate ceviche at a Peruvian restaurant.
My Peruvian friend cooks well.
Peru has a lot of mountains.

explain: 페루 사람들은 주로 스페인어를 써요. ‘페루어’라고 하지 않아요. 브라질은 포르투갈어를 쓰지만 페루, 칠레, 콜롬비아는 스페인어를 써요.
explain_en: Peruvians mainly speak Spanish; Koreans don't say '페루어'. Brazil speaks Portuguese, but Peru, Chile, and Colombia speak Spanish.

examples.ko: 저는 내년에 칠레로 여행을 갈 거예요.
examples.en: I will travel to Chile next year.
I'm Chilean.
I want to go to Chile.
I like Chilean wine.
Chile is very long from top to bottom.
It's summer in Korea. It's winter in Chile.

explain: 고추 같은 “chili”는 “칠리”이고, 나라 이름은 “칠레”예요. 영어로는 소리가 비슷하지만 한국어 글자는 달라요.
explain_en: The chili pepper "chili" is "칠리" and the country is "칠레". They sound alike in English, but the Korean spellings differ.

examples.en: My uncle has worked in Saudi Arabia before.
I'm Saudi.
I want to go to Saudi Arabia.
Saudi Arabia is really hot in the daytime.
My friend's older brother works in Saudi Arabia.
Saudi Arabia has a lot of oil.

explain: 이름이 아주 길어서 보통 “사우디”라고 줄여서 말해요. “사우디 사람”, “사우디 여행”처럼 써요.
explain_en: The name is very long, so people usually shorten it to "사우디", as in "사우디 사람" and "사우디 여행".

examples.en: I'm Iranian.
I want to go to Iran.
Iran is next to Türkiye.
Iran is famous for its carpets.
My Iranian friend drinks tea often.

explain: “이란”과 “이라크”는 이름이 비슷해서 헷갈려요. 둘 다 “이라”로 시작해요. 이란 사람들은 페르시아어를 써요.
explain_en: "이란" and "이라크" have similar names and get mixed up. Both start with "이라". People in 이란 speak Persian.

examples.en: Pakistani food is a little spicy.
I'm Pakistani.
I want to go to Pakistan.
Pakistan is next to India.
My Pakistani friend works at a Korean company.
I had lunch with my Pakistani friend.

explain: “-스탄”으로 끝나는 나라가 많아요. 파키스탄, 카자흐스탄, 아프가니스탄이 그래요. “스탄”은 “땅, 나라”라는 뜻이에요.
explain_en: Many countries end in "-스탄": 파키스탄, 카자흐스탄, 아프가니스탄. "스탄" means "land, country".

examples.ko: 저는 내년에 친구와 같이 네팔에 갈 거예요.
examples.en: I will go to Nepal with my friend next year.
I'm Nepali.
I want to go to Nepal.
The mountains in Nepal are really high.

examples.ko: 네팔 식당은 우리 동네에 하나 있어요.
examples.en: There is one Nepali restaurant in our neighborhood.
My Nepali friend often goes to the mountains.

explain: 한국에서 ‘네팔’ 하면 히말라야와 등산을 많이 떠올려요. 네팔 사람들은 네팔어를 쓰고, 두 손을 모으고 ‘나마스테’라고 인사해요.
explain_en: In Korea, 네팔 brings to mind the Himalayas and mountain climbing. Nepalis speak Nepali and greet with palms together, saying 'Namaste'.

examples.en: I'm Singaporean.
I want to go to Singapore.
Singapore is a small country.
I met a friend at the airport in Singapore.
I went on a trip to Singapore. The food was delicious.

explain: 싱가포르는 도시이면서 나라예요. 끝은 “폴”이 아니라 “포르”로 써요. “싱가폴”은 맞춤법이 틀려요.
explain_en: 싱가포르 is both a city and a country. It ends in "포르", not "폴". "싱가폴" is a spelling mistake.

examples.ko: 저는 다음 달에 홍콩으로 여행을 갈 거예요.
examples.en: I am going to travel to Hong Kong next month.
I'm from Hong Kong.
I want to go to Hong Kong.
My Hong Kong friend lives in Korea.
The night view of Hong Kong is really beautiful.
The buildings in Hong Kong are very tall.

explain: 홍콩은 나라가 아니라 중국의 특별행정구예요. ‘홍콩 사람’이라고는 하지만 말은 ‘홍콩어’가 아니라 ‘광둥어’라고 해요.
explain_en: Hong Kong is not a country but a special administrative region of China. You can say 홍콩 사람, but the language is called 광둥어 (Cantonese), not '홍콩어'.

examples.ko: 지민 씨는 작년에 대만에서 친구를 만났어요.
examples.en: Jimin met a friend in Taiwan last year.
I'm Taiwanese.
I want to go to Taiwan.
I drank milk tea in Taiwan.
Taiwan is close to Korea.
My Taiwanese friend speaks Chinese well.

explain: “대만”과 “태국”은 소리가 비슷해서 헷갈려요. 대만은 Taiwan이고, 태국은 Thailand예요.
explain_en: "대만" and "태국" sound alike and get mixed up. 대만 is Taiwan and 태국 is Thailand.

examples.en: Kazakhstan is a country with a very large territory.
I'm Kazakh.
I want to go to Kazakhstan.
Kazakhstan has a huge land area.
My Kazakh friend is learning Korean.
I met many Koreans in Kazakhstan.

explain: 카자흐스탄에서는 카자흐어와 러시아어를 같이 써요. 이름이 길어서 “카자흐”라고 줄이기도 해요.
explain_en: In 카자흐스탄 people use both Kazakh and Russian. The name is long, so it is sometimes shortened to "카자흐".

examples.ko: 지민이는 우즈베키스탄의 전통 음식을 먹어 봤어요.
examples.en: Jimin tried traditional food from Uzbekistan.
I'm Uzbek.
I want to go to Uzbekistan.
The bread in Uzbekistan is delicious.
My Uzbek friend attends university.
I saw Samarkand in Uzbekistan.

explain: 이름이 아주 길어서 “우즈벡”이라고 줄여서 말해요. “우즈벡 사람”, “우즈벡 음식”처럼 써요.
explain_en: The name is very long, so people shorten it to "우즈벡", as in "우즈벡 사람" and "우즈벡 음식".

examples.ko: 나이지리아는 아프리카에서 인구가 가장 많은 나라 중 하나예요.
examples.en: Nigeria is one of the most populous countries in Africa.
I'm Nigerian.
I want to go to Nigeria.
Nigeria has the most people in Africa.
My Nigerian friend speaks English well.
Nigerian music is popular these days.

explain: “나이지리아”와 “니제르”는 이름이 비슷하지만 다른 나라예요. 사람이 아주 많은 큰 나라는 나이지리아예요.
explain_en: "나이지리아" and "니제르" have similar names but are different countries. The big country with a huge population is 나이지리아.

examples.en: I'm South African.
I want to go to South Africa (short for 남아프리카공화국).
South Africa is in the south of Africa.
My South African friend teaches English in Korea.
The flight from South Africa to Korea is long.

explain: “남아공”은 줄임말이에요. 남(남쪽)+아(프리카)+공(화국)이에요. 보통 말할 때와 쓸 때는 줄임말이 더 많이 나와요.
explain_en: "남아공" is a shortened form: 남 (south) + 아 (프리카) + 공 (화국). In speech and writing, the short form appears more often.

examples.en: I heard that there are really many sheep in New Zealand.
I'm from New Zealand.
I want to go to New Zealand.
Next year I'm going to live in New Zealand with my family.

examples.ko: 뉴질랜드는 한국에서 멀어요? — 네, 아주 멀어요.
examples.en: Is New Zealand far from Korea? — Yes, very far.

examples.ko: 뉴질랜드 친구하고 다음 주에 점심 먹을 거예요.
examples.en: I'm going to have lunch with my New Zealand friend next week.

explain: 뉴질랜드의 ‘랜드’는 영어 land예요. 아일랜드도 같아요. 외국 나라 이름은 영어 소리를 한글로 쓴 것이 많아요.
explain_en: The "랜드" in 뉴질랜드 is English land. 아일랜드 is the same. Many foreign country names are English sounds written in Hangul.

examples.en: My younger sibling is studying English in Ireland.
I'm Irish.
I want to go to Ireland.
My friend studied English in Ireland.

examples.ko: 아일랜드는 날씨가 어때요? — 비가 자주 와요.
examples.en: How's the weather in Ireland? — It rains often.

examples.ko: 다음 달에 아일랜드에서 친구하고 만날 거예요.
examples.en: Next month I'm going to meet a friend in Ireland.

explain: 아일랜드(Ireland)와 아이슬란드(Iceland)는 다른 나라예요. 이름이 비슷해서 많이 헷갈려요.
explain_en: 아일랜드 (Ireland) and 아이슬란드 (Iceland) are different countries. Their names are similar, so they get mixed up a lot.

examples.ko: 포르투갈 음식은 우리나라 입맛에도 잘 맞아요.
examples.en: Portuguese food suits Korean tastes well too.
I'm Portuguese.
I want to go to Portugal.
This summer I'm going to swim in the sea in Portugal.
I talked with a Portuguese person in English.
Shall we meet at a Portuguese restaurant this weekend?

explain: 포르투갈 말은 ‘포르투갈어’예요. 브라질에서도 포르투갈어를 써요.
explain_en: The language of 포르투갈 is "포르투갈어". In 브라질 too, people speak Portuguese (포르투갈어).

examples.en: I heard that the sea in Greece is really beautiful.
I'm Greek.
I want to go to Greece.
I ordered a salad at a Greek restaurant.
I study Korean together with a Greek friend.
Greece is very hot in summer.

explain: 나라 이름 뒤에 ‘어’를 붙이면 그 나라 말이 될 때가 많아요. 그리스어는 Greek이에요. 일본어, 중국어도 같아요.
explain_en: Adding "어" after a country name often gives that country's language. 그리스어 is Greek. 일본어 and 중국어 work the same way.

examples.ko: 스위스에는 눈이 덮인 높은 산이 많아요.
examples.en: There are many tall snow-covered mountains in Switzerland.
I'm Swiss.
I want to go to Switzerland.

examples.ko: 스위스에서 산을 보고 사진을 많이 찍었어요.
examples.en: In Switzerland I looked at the mountains and took lots of photos.
In Switzerland I took a train to a lake.
I rested for two days with a friend at a hotel in Switzerland.

explain: 스위스에는 ‘스위스어’가 없어요. 독일어, 프랑스어, 이탈리아어 같은 말을 써요.
explain_en: There is no "스위스어" in 스위스. People speak languages like 독일어, 프랑스어 and 이탈리아어.

examples.ko: 다음 달에 가족과 함께 오스트리아로 여행을 가요.
examples.en: Next month I'm going on a trip to Austria with my family.
I'm Austrian.
I want to go to Austria.
I went to a concert in Austria.
What's the capital of Austria? — It's Vienna.

examples.ko: 겨울에 친구하고 오스트리아에서 스키를 탈 거예요.
examples.en: This winter I'm going to ski in Austria with a friend.

explain: 오스트리아(Austria)와 오스트레일리아(Australia)는 달라요. 오스트레일리아는 보통 ‘호주’라고 해요.
explain_en: 오스트리아 (Austria) and 오스트레일리아 (Australia) are different. 오스트레일리아 is usually called "호주".

examples.en: It snows a lot in Finland in winter.
I'm Finnish.
I want to go to Finland.
Finland is very cold in winter.
My Finnish friend came to Seoul last week.
I waited for an hour at the airport in Finland.

explain: ‘핀란드’는 [필란드]로 소리 나요. ㄴ과 ㄹ이 만나면 [ㄹㄹ]로 소리 나기 때문이에요. ‘연락[열락]’도 같은 규칙이에요.
explain_en: 핀란드 is pronounced [필란드], because ㄴ followed by ㄹ sounds like [ㄹㄹ]. 연락 [열락] follows the same rule.

examples.ko: 노르웨이는 겨울에 아주 춥고 밤이 길어요.
examples.en: Norway is very cold in winter and the nights are long.
I'm Norwegian.
I want to go to Norway.
In Norway the nights are long in winter.
My Norwegian friend likes kimchi.
What shall we do in Norway? — Shall we take a boat?

explain: ‘산’은 ‘그 나라에서 나온 것’이라는 뜻이에요. 마트에서 ‘노르웨이산 연어’를 자주 볼 수 있어요.
explain_en: '산' means 'from that country'. At the mart you often see '노르웨이산 연어' (Norwegian salmon).

examples.ko: 덴마크에서 온 친구와 함께 커피를 마셨어요.
examples.en: I had coffee with a friend who came from Denmark.
I'm Danish.
I want to go to Denmark.
My Danish friend studies Korean in Seoul.
I have a meeting in Denmark next week.
In Denmark people ride bicycles a lot.

explain: 영어 Danish는 덴마크 사람, 덴마크 말, 덴마크 빵을 모두 말해요. 한국어에서 ‘데니시’는 보통 빵이에요.
explain_en: English Danish means a Dane, the Danish language and Danish pastry. In Korean, '데니시' is usually the pastry.

examples.ko: 저는 올여름에 벨기에로 여행을 갈 거예요.
examples.en: I will travel to Belgium this summer.
I'm Belgian.
I want to go to Belgium.
I ate waffles in Belgium.
From Belgium I go to France by train.
I had lunch with my Belgian friend.

explain: 벨기에는 ‘기에’로 써요. ‘기애’가 아니에요. ‘에’와 ‘애’를 조심하세요.
explain_en: 벨기에 is spelled with "기에", not "기애". Be careful with "에" and "애".

examples.ko: 여름에 친구와 체코에 가서 오래된 도시를 구경할 거예요.
examples.en: This summer I'm going to the Czech Republic with a friend to see old towns.
I'm Czech.
I want to go to Czechia.
I want to study abroad in Czechia.
I went to a Christmas market in Czechia.
Shall we meet my Czech friend at a Korean restaurant?

explain: 체코의 수도 이름은 ‘프라하’예요. 영어 Prague와 소리가 달라서 처음에는 헷갈려요.
explain_en: The capital of 체코 is '프라하'. It sounds different from English Prague, so it is confusing at first.

examples.ko: 지민은 올해 여름에 헝가리로 여행을 갈 거예요.
examples.en: Jimin will travel to Hungary this summer.
I'm Hungarian.
I want to go to Hungary.
I lived in Hungary for a year.
Hungarian dishes have a lot of paprika.
My Hungarian friend's wedding is on Saturday.

explain: 헝가리 사람의 이름은 한국처럼 성이 먼저 와요. 유럽에서는 조금 드문 순서예요.
explain_en: In 헝가리, as in Korea, the family name comes first. That order is a bit rare in Europe.

examples.en: My friend is working in Israel.
I'm Israeli.
I want to go to Israel.
I met my Israeli friend in the park.
Israel is really hot in summer.
Next year I'm going to study in Israel.

explain: ‘이스라엘어’라는 말은 없어요. 많은 사람이 쓰는 말은 ‘히브리어’예요. 나라 이름 + 어 규칙과 달라요.
explain_en: There is no word '이스라엘어'. The language many people speak is '히브리어'. This differs from the country name + 어 rule.

examples.en: I'm Emirati.
I want to go to the United Arab Emirates.
I have a meeting with a company from the UAE.
It's ten hours by plane to the UAE.
My friend from the UAE likes Korean food.

explain: 이름이 길어서 ‘UAE’라고도 해요. 한국어로는 ‘유에이이’라고 읽어요.
explain_en: The name is long, so it is also called 'UAE'. In Korean you read it as '유에이이'.

examples.ko: 방글라데시에서 온 친구가 우리 반에 있어요.
examples.en: There is a friend from Bangladesh in our class.
I'm Bangladeshi.
I want to go to Bangladesh.
My Bangladeshi friend works at a company in Seoul.
I have family in Bangladesh.
During vacation I'm going to meet a friend in Bangladesh.

explain: ‘방글라’는 벵골 말이고 ‘데시’는 ‘나라’라는 뜻이에요. 방글라데시는 ‘벵골 사람들의 나라’예요.
explain_en: '방글라' means Bengali and '데시' means 'country'. 방글라데시 is 'the country of the Bengali people'.

examples.en: I will travel to Sri Lanka in the summer.
I'm Sri Lankan.
I want to go to Sri Lanka.
I drank black tea in Sri Lanka.
I had curry with my Sri Lankan friend.
In Sri Lanka I took a train to a tea field.

explain: 스리랑카 사람들은 ‘싱할라어’와 ‘타밀어’를 많이 써요. ‘스리랑카어’라는 말은 쓰지 않아요.
explain_en: People in 스리랑카 mostly speak '싱할라어' and '타밀어'. The word '스리랑카어' is not used.

examples.en: Myanmar is a country in Asia.
I'm from Myanmar.
I want to go to Myanmar.
My Myanmar friend works in Seoul.

examples.ko: 미얀마는 지금 몇 시예요? — 여섯 시예요.
examples.en: What time is it in Myanmar now? — It's six o'clock.

examples.ko: 내년에 미얀마에 갈 거예요. 친구가 거기에 살아요.
examples.en: I'm going to Myanmar next year. A friend lives there.

explain: 미얀마의 옛 이름은 ‘버마’예요. 나이 많은 사람들은 아직 ‘버마’라고 말하기도 해요. 미얀마 사람들은 미얀마어를 써요.
explain_en: Myanmar's old name is 버마 (Burma), and older people sometimes still use it. People there speak Burmese (미얀마어).

examples.ko: 지민 씨는 캄보디아에서 유명한 사원을 구경했어요.
examples.en: Jimin visited a famous temple in Cambodia.
I'm Cambodian.
I want to go to Cambodia.
I looked around a temple in Cambodia.
My Cambodian friend likes Korean songs.
Cambodia is hot all year round.

explain: 캄보디아 말은 ‘크메르어’예요. ‘캄보디아어’보다 ‘크메르어’라는 이름을 더 많이 써요.
explain_en: The language of 캄보디아 is '크메르어'. The name '크메르어' is used more than '캄보디아어'.

examples.ko: 친구와 함께 라오스에 가서 맛있는 음식을 먹었어요.
examples.en: I went to Laos with a friend and ate delicious food.
I'm Lao.
I want to go to Laos.
I bought coffee in Laos.
During summer vacation I met a friend in Laos.
Shall we eat rice noodles at a Lao restaurant?

explain: 라오스는 바다가 없는 나라예요. 이런 나라를 ‘내륙국’이라고도 해요.
explain_en: 라오스 has no sea. Such a country is also called an '내륙국' (landlocked country).

examples.en: Cuban music is really lively and fun.
I'm Cuban.
I want to go to Cuba.
I want to learn Spanish in Cuba.

examples.ko: 쿠바 음악 좋아해요? — 네, 아주 좋아해요.
examples.en: Do you like Cuban music? — Yes, I like it a lot.

examples.ko: 내년에 친구하고 쿠바에서 한 달 있을 거예요.
examples.en: Next year I'm going to stay in Cuba for a month with a friend.

explain: 쿠바는 카리브해에 있는 섬나라예요. ‘섬’은 바다 가운데에 있는 땅이에요.
explain_en: 쿠바 is an island country in the Caribbean Sea. A '섬' is land in the middle of the sea.

examples.ko: 모로코의 시장에는 예쁜 그릇이 아주 많아요.
examples.en: The markets in Morocco have a lot of pretty bowls.
I'm Moroccan.
I want to go to Morocco.
I looked around the markets in Morocco.
Morocco is very far from Korea.
Shall we have lunch at a Moroccan restaurant?

explain: 모로코 사람들은 아랍어와 베르베르어를 쓰고, 프랑스어도 많이 써요. 한국에서는 ‘모로코’ 하면 사막과 파란 골목이 있는 여행지를 많이 떠올려요.
explain_en: Moroccans speak Arabic and Berber, and French is widely used too. In Korea, 모로코 calls to mind a travel destination with deserts and blue alleyways.

examples.ko: 동생은 케냐에서 코끼리를 보고 싶어 해요.
examples.en: My younger brother wants to see elephants in Kenya.
I'm Kenyan.
I want to go to Kenya.
One cup of Kenyan coffee, please.
Kenya is in the east of Africa.
My Kenyan friend goes to a university in Seoul.

explain: 카페 메뉴에서 ‘케냐’라는 이름을 볼 수 있어요. 커피 원두 이름으로 쓰는 경우가 많아요.
explain_en: You may see the name '케냐' on cafe menus. It is often used as the name of a coffee bean.

examples.ko: 루마니아에서 온 친구와 같이 한국어를 공부해요.
examples.en: I study Korean together with a friend from Romania.
I'm Romanian.
I want to go to Romania.
I work together with a Romanian friend.
Romania has a lot of mountains.
Shall we meet my Romanian friend at the market?

explain: ‘드라큘라’ 이야기의 배경은 루마니아의 지역이에요. 그래서 한국 책이나 영화에서 루마니아 이름이 나와요.
explain_en: The setting of the 'Dracula' story is a region of 루마니아. That is why 루마니아 appears in Korean books and movies.
